result.reason: The operative clause includes all preferred coverages and limits: CGL at USD 1M/2M, E&O at USD 2M, cyber at USD 5M when HDI processes relevant Company information, workers’ compensation as required by law, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing provision. However, requiring every policy to remain in place for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is unnecessary, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation. The cyber trigger also extends beyond Customer Data to any Company Confidential Information.
